  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (k >= 1)

  requires (k <= 100)

  ensures ((result == 0) == ((n % k) == 0))
  ensures ((result == 1) == ((n % k) != 0))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
